responsibility: Implements the scoped availability and equivalence tables used by dominator-based tree-SSA optimizers such as DOM and jump-thread reasoning. It manages unwindable stacks of available expressions and const/copy facts across dominator traversal, simplifies expressions using recorded equalities and memory-state information, hashes and compares hashable_expr forms, records conditions implied by edges, and provides the mechanics behind entering/leaving scopes and restoring prior table entries when traversal backtracks.
same_name_distinction: This .c file implements the scoped dominator-walk tables: it updates and unwinds available-expression and const/copy state, performs expression hashing/simplification, and records edge-implied conditions during traversal. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-scopedtables.h, it is not the declaration-only definition of hashable_expr, cond_equivalence, and the stack/table classes.
